name: number-one
description: Number One: an all-in-one Discord server administration bot with a built-in web dashboard.
comment: Build tools (esbuild, vite) are regular dependencies on purpose: Wispbyte runs `npm install`, and .npmrc tells it to skip devDependencies to save disk space, but the build needs them. index.js builds on start (scripts/build.mjs), after npm install has exited, and skips the build when nothing changed. The bot is built with esbuild, not tsc, because tsc needs more memory than the Wispbyte server has. TypeScript, the @types packages, drizzle-kit and tsx are devDependencies: only needed on your own computer. Install them with `npm install --include=dev`, then check types with `npm run typecheck`.
